item.description:
When: Tuesday 24 November 2026, 20:00
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

For our November meet-up, we will be welcoming Christopher Daly & Samson Nwizugbe **Samson Nwizugbe** \- Process Managers\, Not Process\-Aware Aggregates: Coordinating Long\-Running Workflows in DDD with Wolverine When a workflow spans several aggregates, the logic tends to end up in one of two bad places. Either it sits in a god-class orchestrator that knows too much about everything downstream, or it leaks into the aggregates themselves until they're tracking steps, waiting on other aggregates and making decisions that have nothing to do with their own invariants.
